Title: Moderator has too many buttons, they override the page numbers

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Hello,
As a moderator on some forums, I have access to the Moderator options on threads ([un]sticky, lock, moderate, ...).
These are on the same line the pages of the post are. When the thread reaches 5 pages, it is impossible to click on the number of any page beyond 4, as they are pushed in the margin.
